translation.en: He said in al-Fiqh al-Akbar: The intercession of the prophets, upon them blessing and peace, is true, and the intercession of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, is for the believers and the sinners, and for those of them who committed great sins and deserve punishment.

translation.en: He said in the transmission of Muhammad, al-Balkhi, Ibn al-Muzaffar and al-Harithi: Nuh b. Qays related to me, from Yazid al-Raqashi, from Anas, who said: We said, O Messenger of God, for whom will you intercede on the Day of Resurrection? He said: For the people of great sins, the people of enormities, and the people of blood.

translation.en: Salama b. Kuhayl related to me, from Abu al-Za'ra', from Ibn Mas'ud; and Yazid b. Suhayb, from Jabir, from him, upon him blessing and peace, that he said: By my intercession the people of faith will surely come out of the Fire, until none remains in it but the people of this verse: What brought you into Saqar? They said: We were not of those who prayed, nor did we feed the poor; we used to plunge with those who plunged, and we used to deny the Day of Judgement, until the certainty came to us. So the intercession of the intercessors does not profit them.
translation.tr: Bana Seleme b. Küheyl, Ebü'z-Za'râ'dan, o İbn Mes'ûd'dan; ve Yezîd b. Suheyb, Câbir'den, o Nebî'den -aleyhissalâtü vesselâm- rivâyet etti ki şöyle buyurdu: Îmân ehli şefaatimle ateşten mutlaka çıkacak; orada şu âyetin ehlinden başkası kalmayacak: Sizi Sekar'a sokan nedir? Dediler: Namaz kılanlardan değildik, yoksulu doyurmazdık, dalanlarla birlikte dalardık, hesap gününü yalanlardık; nihayet yakîn (ölüm) bize geldi. Artık şefaatçilerin şefaati onlara fayda vermez.

translation.en: 'Atiyya b. Sa'd al-'Awfi related to me, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; and 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, from 'Abdallah b. 'Abbas; and Hammad, from Rib'i b. Hirash, from Hudhayfa, may God the Exalted be pleased with them all, and they from the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said concerning His word, the Exalted, 'perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station': the praised station is intercession. God the Exalted punishes a people of the people of faith for their sins, then brings them out by the intercession of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace; they are brought to a river called Life and wash in it, then enter the Garden, and in the Garden they are called 'the Hell-folk'; then they ask God, and that name departs from them, and they are called the freedmen of God.
translation.tr: Bana Atıyye b. Sa'd el-Avfî, Ebû Saîd el-Hudrî'den; Abdülmelik b. Umeyr, Abdullah b. Abbâs'tan; Hammâd, Rib'î b. Hırâş'tan, o Huzeyfe'den -radıyallâhu anhüm- rivâyet etti; onlar da Nebî'den -sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem- rivâyet etti ki Allah Teâlâ'nın "Umulur ki Rabbin seni övülmüş bir makama yükseltir" sözü hakkında şöyle buyurdu: Makām-ı Mahmûd şefaattir. Allah Teâlâ îmân ehlinden bir topluluğa günahları yüzünden azap eder, sonra onları Muhammed'in -sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem- şefaatiyle çıkarır; Hayat denilen bir nehre getirilirler, orada yıkanırlar, sonra cennete girerler; cennette "cehennemlikler" diye adlandırılırlar. Sonra Allah'tan dilerler, bu ad onlardan gider ve "Allah'ın âzâdlıları" diye adlandırılırlar.

irab.tr: «bunun üzerine» + muzâri fiil, merfû.

irab.ar: «فِي» حَرْفُ جَرٍّ، وَالْهَاءُ ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِلٌ مَبْنِيٌّ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ.

irab.en: «then» — the conjunction of sequence.
irab.tr: «sonra» — tertip bildiren atıf harfi.

irab.ar: فِعْلٌ مُضَارِعٌ مَرْفُوعٌ، وَعَلَامَةُ رَفْعِهِ ثُبُوتُ النُّونِ، وَالْوَاوُ ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِلٌ فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ فَاعِلٌ.

irab.tr: Muzâri fiil, merfû.

irab.en: The object (maf'ul bihi), in nasb; the sign is the fatha.
irab.tr: Mef'ûlün bih, mansûb; alâmeti fetha ile.

irab.tr: «bunun üzerine» + muzâri fiil, merfû.

irab.ar: نَعْتٌ مَجْرُورٌ بِالْيَاءِ لِأَنَّهُ جَمْعُ مُذَكَّرٍ سَالِمٌ.
irab.en: An adjective (na't) agreeing with its noun in case; the sign is the ya — a sound masculine plural.
irab.tr: Sıfat (na't); mevsûfuna uyar; alâmeti yâ ile — cem'-i müzekker sâlim.

irab.tr: «bunun üzerine» + muzâri fiil, merfû; fâili gizli zamir «هُوَ».

irab.ar: «عَنْ» حَرْفُ جَرٍّ، وَالْهَاءُ ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِلٌ مَبْنِيٌّ فِي مَحَلِّ جَرٍّ.

irab.en: a demonstrative — built (mabni).

irab.en: A substitute (badal); the same case as its head; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: Bedel; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.ar: مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ مَجْرُورٌ بِالْفَتْحَةِ نِيَابَةً عَنِ الْكَسْرَةِ لِأَنَّهُ مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ.
irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the fatha in place of the kasra — a diptote.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre yerine fetha ile — gayr-i munsarif.
